_comment: Fleet registry: the single source of truth for (a) which app owns which host-port block, and (b) which subdomain every homelab service is reached at. Allocate T3 apps via scripts/port-registry.py; hand-edit infra_services. See SKILL.md § Port Allocation and § Ingress & DNS.

scheme._container_note: Container-internal port = the service's PROD host port (1:1 host:container, e.g. 6000:6000) EXCEPT for services listed in container_ports below. We do NOT use 3000 for web — Grafana owns 3000 on the homelab. Postgres always binds 5432 internally (it's network-internal only), so it is the one fixed override.

ingress._comment: How services are exposed. PRIMARY path is the preference; serve is the fallback.

primary.summary: Traefik owns host 0.0.0.0:443 (covers LAN AND the tailnet IP in one bind), terminates *.leonardoacosta.dev with a Cloudflare DNS-01 wildcard cert, and Host-routes to each backend. tailscaled MUST NOT hold :443 or it shadows Traefik.
primary.cert: Cloudflare DNS-01 wildcard via Traefik certResolver 'cloudflare' (CF_DNS_API_TOKEN). Cloudflare stays the cert authority — do not replace.
primary.host_native_backend: http://172.20.0.1:<port> (docker gateway) for services not in a container (homebridge, t3code)

dns.tailnet_record: Public Cloudflare A record *.leonardoacosta.dev -> host tailnet IP (100.73.182.4), GREY-CLOUD / DNS-only (Cloudflare cannot proxy a 100.x CGNAT address). Only tailnet peers can route there; the wildcard cert + tailnet ACL gate access.
dns.lan_record: AdGuard manifest (homelab/adguardhome/rewrites.yaml) rewrites *.leonardoacosta.dev -> tailnet IP for LAN clients. Coexists with the public record.
dns.apex: leonardoacosta.dev apex stays on Vercel (public site); never wildcard-captured.

fallback.summary: tailscale serve --https=<port> for host-native daemons or a quick HTTPS URL when a Traefik route isn't wired. URL is <host>.ts.net:<port>, NOT a custom domain (tailscaled has no leonardoacosta.dev cert). If the app binds *:<port> it shadows serve on that same port — serve on a distinct free port. See SKILL.md § Exposing a service over Tailscale.
